confirmedFacts: The published-product snapshots were captured from Landometer web properties at the owner's direction.
Landometer and CityMETER are controlled by the same owner.

publicationBoundary: This confirmation resolves owner authority and provenance for reuse of these existing rendered captures between owner-controlled Landometer properties.

This confirmation does not change a provider licence, create an endorsement claim or authorize removal of attribution.
